changelog:
ClawLaunch 1.0.0

- Initial release of the ClawLaunch skill.
- Launch and trade AI agent tokens on a bonding curve with 95% creator fee share.
- Automatic Uniswap V4 graduation for tokens reaching a configurable liquidity threshold.
- Fixed 1% trading fee and Privy wallet support for autonomous agents.
- Includes commands for token launch, listing, price quoting, trading, and on-chain memo protocol.
- Supports both Base Mainnet and Base Sepolia testnet.
summary: Launch and trade AI agent tokens on ClawLaunch bonding curve (Base). Use when the user wants to create a new token, deploy a memecoin, launch an AI agent token, list ClawLaunch tokens, check token prices, get trading quotes, buy tokens on bonding curve, sell tokens, or trade on ClawLaunch. Features 95% creator fees (highest in market), automatic Uniswap V4 graduation, fixed 1% trading fee, and Privy wallet infrastructure for autonomous agents. Supports Base Mainnet and Base Sepolia testnet.
